Fabrik

An industrial site centred on special metal loot boxes.

Aktivitäten

Find and open the special metal boxes; the official update describes several routes through the area.

Ertrag

The boxes offer valuable loot, with contents varying by spawn.

Risiken

Watch for other players while searching the routes; this is not a marked safe zone.

Recycler

For recycling, visit a gas station, parking lot, town, warehouse, Lumberjack or Miner.
